title: Drift Wood #35 · the phantom
logline: The graphic novel is mentioned for the first time. It already has a title. It changes by the fourth panel.

panels.composition: The cafeteria. WOOD with a spiral notebook held to his chest like the overcoat isn't enough. CHLOE and GULLY across the table.

balloons.text: I've begun the real work. A graphic novel. It's called SLASH.

image.prompt: a teenage boy in an overcoat clutching a spiral notebook to his chest at a cafeteria table across from a girl with eyeliner and a boy in a backwards cap

balloons.text: A timber town. A crime. A man who—

image.prompt: close-up of a teenage girl asking flat questions across a cafeteria table

panels.composition: Gully, reaching for the notebook. Wood pulling it back.

balloons.text: It's not ready. Also the title's changing. It's called THE LONG WAY BACK now.

image.prompt: a boy in a backwards cap reaching for a spiral notebook that another boy pulls protectively away

panels.composition: Wood, alone at the end of lunch, opening the notebook. Page one. Two lines of pencil and the title, crossed out twice, and a third one: CEDAR.
props: notebook page one with crossed-out titles

image.prompt: a teenage boy alone at a cafeteria table opening a spiral notebook to its first page: two pencil lines and a title crossed out twice with a third written beneath, black and white
image.notes: The three titles — SLASH, THE LONG WAY BACK, CEDAR — are the corner boxes of 2002, 2008, 2016. Letter after if needed.

notes: All three phantom titles in one panel, seventeen years early. Nobody in the strip will remember.
